name: carplay_tilt_1607
what: carplay_tilt (see tilt_1703.json) for HMI ID5_1607-490-1610T Build 153 (NBTevo_ID5_1607_Release, BMW F20, read from a car; issue #8). CCarPlayActivity::handleControllerInput is at 0x8b568c there; every patched place has the same instructions at the same distances as in 1703 Build 139 (only the proxy offset in the send call's argument setup differs: +0x4d64), so the new words are 1703's, the key filter's branch keeping its own offset.
how: 0x8b56f4..0x8b56fc: the key filter becomes 9..14 (bhi to the same exit 0x8b59a8)
0x8b58f0: tilt left no longer sets the Back field
0x8b589c..0x8b58cc: zero the four direction words, store "pressed" in the one of key-9, Voice field as before, b 0x8b593c (the send call)
0x8b5918: b 0x8b589c instead of the original argument setup
Mapped by matching handleControllerInput with 1703 Build 139 (the installer's tA, tB, tC windows; tB with the proxy immediates masked) and checked instruction by instruction.
